name: chc_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for CHC Farm Machinery rental authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: chc_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT create bookings. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: chc_get_chc_list
description: Returns list of Custom Hiring Centres in a region with location, contact, and supported machinery. PUBLIC tool — no authentication required. Does NOT check machinery availability. Fails if location invalid or no CHCs found.

name: chc_search_machinery
description: Searches available farm machinery at CHC centres by type, location, and date. Returns machinery details and availability. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT book machinery. May return machinery that is reserved for other time slots. Fails if no machinery matches or location invalid.

name: chc_check_availability
description: Checks if specific machinery is available for a given date and time slot. Returns availability_status ('available', 'reserved', 'unavailable') and machinery_status ('operational', 'in_use', 'maintenance', 'unavailable'). PUBLIC tool. Does NOT book. Fails if machinery_id invalid or date is in the past.

machinery_id.description: Unique identifier of the farm machinery.

name: chc_create_booking
description: Books farm machinery for a specific date and duration. Transitions booking_status to 'requested'. Machinery must be available and operational. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee confirmation until CHC confirms. Fails if machinery unavailable, overlapping booking exists, booking duration exceeds limits, or date is in the past.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

land_area_acres.description: Area to be serviced in acres. Optional.

name: chc_track_booking
description: Tracks booking_status ('requested', 'confirmed', 'active', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'failed'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify booking. Fails if booking_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: chc_modify_booking
description: Modifies an existing booking (date, duration). Only possible when booking_status is 'requested' or 'confirmed'. Requires session_token. Does NOT create new bookings. Fails if booking is already active, completed, or cancelled, or new slot has conflicts.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: chc_cancel_booking
description: Cancels a booking. Only when 'requested' or 'confirmed'. Transitions to 'cancelled'. Requires session_token. Does NOT refund. Fails if booking already active or completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: chc_track_payment
description: Tracks payment_status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'completed', 'failed'). Some bookings require advance payment. Requires session_token. Does NOT process payments. Fails if booking_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: chc_get_booking_history
description: Retrieves all past bookings for the farmer. Requires session_token. Does NOT create bookings. Fails if no history exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: chc_resolve_booking_conflict
description: Resolves overlapping or conflicting booking requests by suggesting alternative slots. Requires session_token. Does NOT auto-rebook. Fails if no alternatives available.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: chc_get_nearest_chc
description: Returns the nearest CHC centres with distance and availability summary. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT book machinery. Fails if location invalid.

name: chc_get_machinery_details
description: Returns detailed info about specific machinery (type, capacity, hourly rate, condition). PUBLIC tool. Does NOT check availability. Fails if machinery_id invalid.

name: chc_validate_time_slot
description: Validates whether a requested time slot is available without creating a booking. Returns validity and conflicts. PUBLIC tool. Fails if machinery_id or date invalid.

name: chc_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance. Categories: 'booking_failure', 'machinery_unavailable', 'payment_issue', 'scheduling_conflict', 'service_issue'. Must check booking status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: chc_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks CHC grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.
